test_environment: isolated headless Chromium, desktop 1440x900, no hosted navigation; 12 synchronous SVG rebuild observations after 3 warmups per version
scene: 3840 total model objects, 1100 far-offscreen segments, 180 on-viewport segments, supporting 2560 point anchors, labels/grid/axes off
conclusion: Median isolated SVG rebuild reduced from 20.45 ms to 6.30 ms (about 69% lower) with fewer offscreen DOM nodes. No global FPS guarantee. Changes in DOM counts include hit targets.
reproducibility: Run python tests/browser_cut17_performance.py against extracted Cut16 and Cut17 roots using optional root argument; the test source is included in Cut17 ZIP.
limits: JS module inlined due to sandbox HTTP navigation restriction
synthetic geometry, not an actual mixed paper diagram
font and bitmap export latency not included
